notes.title: Airi's Adventure v1.4.2 is now updated!
notes.content:
[h3]Airi's Adventure v1.4.2 is now updated![/h3]

- [b]Added a chapter selection scene for the 2nd run[/b]. 
[i]After clearing the game[/i], now you can play from a certain chapter to enjoy the story or to collect the achievements.
In this way, Airi and Luca will have their default Classes, and you can only have the given Level/Gold/Items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34092044/bf9fb2080546805c097dedd088ae25a45272a99c.jpg[/img]

- [b]Added a Sticker Collection, which works as an in-game achievement system[/b]. 
The stickers are the same as the Steam achievements. I hope those who play the Light version or whose achievements don't work can enjoy collecting the achievements as well.
Plus some new drawings!
(You'll have to collect the stickers again even if you've collected the achievements, except for the endings).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34092044/2b1e372a6a86a730bec341be215a441e29149bfc.jpg[/img]

- Added portraits for Rosie and Melissa (because why not)
- Added portraits for Katarina, BC, Andrea and the travelling Mirabell, because I really wanted to draw them and finally had time!  
The new drawings are also updated in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1153020/Airis_Adventure_Art_Book/]Art Book DLC[/url]. Please check the previous news for the details!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34092044/911781b007c7fccafd9f93191f696cbe3970c59f.jpg[/img]

- Fixed some typos and minor bugs
- A few changes on maps, shops and NPCs, which do not affect the story or gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34092044/4dc6a2d8ba73194cb49acffcd3ce15145c7ae2ab.jpg[/img]

- The [b]second run save data[/b] is also included in the local files. Please check it if you've lost your original save data and would like play it on the second run.


◇    ◇    ◇
[b]Known problems:[/b]
- The missing icon problem still exits, and the solution remains: [u]run the game on Vista Compatibility Mode[/u].
It looks like you'll need to [u]set it again[/u] every time when the game is updated.
- It's still laggy when playing on Steam. If you do have problem running the game, please consider playing the [u]Light version[/u]. It's included in the local files.

Really sorry about the inconvenience and thank you all for the patience and support!!


◇    ◇    ◇
[h3]Please also...[/h3]
- Please [u]leave a review[/u] if you enjoyed the game! Reviews are very important to an indie dev...
- Please check the sequel Rosie's Road of Love (and maybe leave a review)!!
A score can only be generated with over 10 reviews...(and positive over 50 reviews...)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1509790/The_Other_Rosies_Road_of_Love/

- Set "[u]show more[/u]" in the news section in the Steam Library if you're interested! 
The news are just filtered if you don't play the game recently...ːtwtptomatoː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34092044/67d4482adb20636980c834d769f0ca609dfcb16d.jpg[/img]

(but sure you can show less if you don't want to read them!^^;)


- Join [url=https://discord.gg/4aHmkjNdZ4]Rabbiton Discord[/url]! ~ 
So that you can be updated with news big or small, or just have a [strike]quiet[/strike]relaxing space on the internet...
- Check the [url=https://www.patreon.com/rabbitongames/]Patreon Page[/url], to get some exclusive contents and support the future development/website maintenance...
Please consider becoming a patreon! ([i]I'll hang there for a bit longer, if nobody comes I think it's the time to close it[/i]...;v;)

- ːtwtpwitchː [i]The Witches Tea Party[/i] celebrates its 5-year-anniversary this August!


For regular news and dev progress:
[url=https://ameliaandfriends.tumblr.com/]Dev blog[/url] | [url=https://twitter.com/Rabbitongames]Twitter[/url]


◇    ◇    ◇
I'm really happy that I finally have some time to work on [i]Airi's Adventure[/i] again. I know it's not perfect, but this project always means a lot to me. 
It's an honour to share my beloved world with you, and it's a great encouragement to know (at least some of) you enjoy the game.

Thank you again for all the support!
Please take care and stay hydratedːtwtpbearː

notes.title: News and Rosie's Story!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34092044/05a9c6bd60468448de8a2725ac5abaf00709e356.jpg[/img]

Art by Shencao

Hope you enjoy!

[h3]About RRoL's interaction with Airi's Adventure's savedata[/h3]
If you have finished the True Ending of Airi's Adventure,
copy [i]global.rpgsave[/i] and [i]config.rpgsave[/i] in AA's local folder to RRoL's save folder,
then you can have some extra contents in your FIRST gameplay.
They're also available after clearing RRoL.

The story happens after Lillian's party has saved world, so you'll see people talking about it...but no AA key spoiler is included in RRoL. Please enjoy it as a new journey~
It doesn't matter if you haven't played AA either. AA will be like a [strike]giant easter egg[/strike] prequel after RRoL. Please play at your own pace!


Aaaaannd some exciting news!

[h3]1) The new official website is online now! [/h3]
Thanks to Vilja (who's also the programmer of T&TR)! 
You can check all the news, game information, walkthroughs on the website, and more contents are planning to be updated.

[h3]2) A Popularity Vote![/h3]
This is going to be [url=https://www.rabbitongames.com/survey/the-3rd-popularity-vote/]the 3rd Popularity Vote[/url], to celebrate RRoL's release and T&T's 5 year(!) anniversary. The 1st & 2nd results can be found in the news of the previous games. 

* You don't have to play all the games to vote.
* End Date is to be announced, but at least it'll be the end of August. Please take your time playing!


[h3]3) Art Book making and Fan Art Event![/h3]
An Art Book is also going to be made this time, in the following weeks.

Here we have the old fan art event again!
If there is anyone interested in submitting fan art for the Art Book now it's the time~
You'll recieve a copy for free if your art is included in the book!
It’s not a contest (and properly not many submissions) so don't worry, just join if you're interested.
~ [url=https://www.rabbitongames.com/event-calling-for-fan-art/]Read the detailed rules here[/url] ~

That's another step of my RPG journey, Thank you very much for your support! 
It's not easy for a small solo dev. I do appreciate it. I'd be grateful if you stay around for my future plans!
Please take care and have fun playing!ːtwtpbearː

notes.title: Vista Compatibility Mode to Fix Menu, and Update Notice
notes.content:
I've been trying to fix the Menu missing icon/text problem since the game is released on Steam...but I'm terribly sorry to say that there's still no proper solution.
The best way to solve this problem is, for now,  as a player posted in the discussion (thank you so much!), to run the game in [b]Vista Compatibility Mode[/b].

If the icons or text in the menu disappear during your gameplay, [h3]please find your local game folder, right click on "game.exe", and choose Properties >> Vista compatibility mode.[/h3]

It's just sad and frustrated that the problem is still not fully solved. I'm very grateful for your patience and understanding T-T
I'm really sorry about that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34092044/1710a8e2b77f593ac7a89a8102acf0b6f1f9dc91.jpg[/img]

In the new v1.2 version:
[list]
[*]The game's UI is changed to a simpler one, [/strike]tho sadly the trouble still remains, more or less.[/strike]
[*]Therefore a trouble shooting message is added at the beginning of the Steam version (when click New Game), to tell the players about the Vista Compatibility Mode.
[*]...and a 2nd-run easy achievement is added.
[*]Fixed a few typos and bugs (including adjusting Ryan's boss fight), and added a few new random title screens.
[*]Your savedata (including the demo's) are still playable in this version.
[*]You may need to set the compatibility mode again for the future updates (because the game.exe would be updated).
[/list]
Sorry again about the trouble m(_ _)m

The Light version is okay because it's not built on Steam,
but I'll update it to the new-UI-version as well.
I kinda like the new choices. Hope you'll enjoy it as well T^T

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34092044/e6da2f7529c1ab504be374a3f602f513f4bdd723.jpg[/img]

I cannot thank you enough for your support and understanding.
